title: Role configuration (_ai/roles/<role>/role-config.yaml)
description: A role's configuration beside its role.md. Edited in the Role Editor (@T: Open Role Editor).

roleType.description: The role type (a folder of _ai/role-types/) whose configuration the role takes, e.g. its tools. Absent: the profile's defaults.

guidelines.description: The role's guideline choices, over its role type's: an aspect (a folder of _ai/aspect_guidelines/) mapped to a choice's short name, or to `remove` (nothing is sent for that aspect). An aspect without an entry inherits from the levels above (Don't add). Absent: no choices. Several choices are a list: it replaces the levels below's choices, or adds to them when every entry starts with `+` (`[+react]`); a single choice stays a string.
